dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Kaos is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Kaos has been observed to be highly stressed; noted to baulk, headwhip and thrash while on leash when returning to kennel. In kennel, Kaos has been observed to be heavily panting, salivating, and pawing at the kennel door to the point of bleeding. This behavior is not able to be redirected consistently. While out with handlers, Kaos has not displayed any reactivity and allows petting. In his previous home, Kaos is noted to be a social, affectionate, couch potato. Medically, Kaos is currently on treatment for CIRDC.
dog.name: Kaos
